sections.title: Real readings, where your browser has them
sections.intro: The demo feeds the wallpaper the same readings your phone would, through the app's own code, so units, clocks and warning lights behave as they do in the app.

items.title: The clock
items.text: Your browser's own time, in your time zone, with your 12 or 24-hour clock.

items.title: Your battery
items.text: Its level and charging, in Chrome, Edge and Samsung Internet. Safari and Firefox show the demo's.

items.title: Your real speed
items.text: Tap Use my real speed and allow your location. It stays in your browser. Watch it only as a passenger.

items.title: A demo drive for the rest
items.text: Power, CPU clock, RAM, signal, Bluetooth and the music come from a 26-second drive, as in the app's previews.

sections.title: About Speedometer Live Wallpaper
sections.intro: Speedometer Live Wallpaper turns an Android home screen into a working car dashboard. It isn't a picture: the needles follow what your phone is really doing, from the power flowing into or out of its battery to the processor's clock speed or, on the road, your GPS speed. It runs on Android 8.0 or newer, on phones, foldables and tablets.

items.title: One dial, three readings
items.text: Battery power in watts, the processor's clock or GPS speed in km/h or mph. A tap on the home screen moves the dial to the next one.

items.title: Gauges all around it
items.text: Battery level and temperature, memory in use, mobile signal, Wi-Fi and its link speed, a clock and a date, and warning lights for Bluetooth, charging and heat.

items.title: Layouts of your own
items.text: Drag and resize any style's gauges and keep the arrangement, or open the layout market and use one that another driver built.

items.title: Free to start
items.text: Classic, Steel and Graphite cost nothing. Each other style is a one-time purchase, and it follows your Google account to a new phone.

sections.title: Getting the most from the demo

items: Wait a few seconds while the engine loads: it is the app's own drawing code, running in your browser instead of on a phone.
Tap the big gauge to cycle through power, CPU clock and speed, exactly as you would on your home screen.
Flip through the styles in the panel, try each one's layouts, and change its colours, units and lights under Settings.
Rotate the phone, lay home-screen icons over it or go full screen, then copy a link to the look you made and send it on.

items.q: Will the app look exactly like this?
items.a: Yes. This page runs the same drawing code as the app, checked picture by picture against the app's own screenshots, so a style you like here looks the same behind your icons.

items.q: Does the demo use my location?
items.a: Only after you tap Use my real speed and allow it when your browser asks. Your speed is worked out on this page and never sent anywhere, and Back to the demo drive stops it.
No. The app works without one. Signing in with a free VHub account is optional: it keeps a backup of your settings and lets you share your own layouts in the market.

items.q: What does a premium style cost?
items.a: Its price shows beside its name in the panel above. You pay once on Google Play, and the style stays yours on every phone signed in to the same Google account.
No. iPhones don't let apps draw a live wallpaper, so Speedometer is for Android only: phones, tall Flip screens, foldables and tablets.
